blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound difficult, but in English they follow simple patterns. Today we look at tax day at work. On this day, the fiscal team has a lot to do, but the steps are always the same.

First, the team works with the numbers. They check every line, because the numbers must be correct. Then they send the form to the manager. The manager reads it and signs it. After that, the team files the form in the fiscal folder.

These five words — work, check, send, sign and file — come back every month. You do not need difficult English for taxes. Short sentences are enough. One small step at a time, and the day is easy.

items.q: What does the fiscal team do FIRST on tax day?
items.why: "First, the team works with the numbers."

items.q: Why does the team check every line?
options: Because the numbers must be correct
Because it is a new form
items.why: "They check every line, because the numbers must be correct."

items.q: Who signs the form?
items.why: "The manager reads it and signs it."

items.q: The text suggests that tax day is…
options: not so hard, because the steps repeat
items.why: Inferência: "the steps are always the same… One small step at a time, and the day is easy."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "The five words come back every month."
"You need very difficult English for taxes."
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "You do not need difficult English for taxes."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falar sobre o dia de imposto no trabalho. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! My name is Sophie. I work in the fiscal team at Czarnikow. Today is tax day, and it is a busy day for me. But I like it.

First, I come to the office early. I make a coffee and I open my computer. I look at the tax calendar on the wall. Today we have one big form to send.

I work with the numbers first. I check every line two times, because the numbers must be correct. Then I send the form to my manager. He reads it, and he signs it at the bottom.

After that, I file the form. I put it in the fiscal folder, and we keep it for seven years. It is the rule here.

I like tax day because the steps are simple and always the same. Check, send, sign, file. I do this every month, so it is easy for me now.

At the end of the day, I am a little tired, but I am happy. The work is correct and the form is ready. See you next month!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
options: In the fiscal team at Czarnikow
items.why: "I work in the fiscal team at Czarnikow."

items.q: How many times does Sophie check every line?
items.why: "I check every line two times."

items.q: For how long does the team keep the form?
items.why: "we keep it for seven years."

items.q: Why is tax day easy for Sophie now?
options: Because she does the same steps every month
Because the manager does her work
Because the numbers are always wrong
Because there is no form today
items.why: Inferência: "I do this every month, so it is easy for me now."

items.q: How does Sophie feel about tax day?
options: She is a little tired, but happy
items.why: Inferência: "I am a little tired, but I am happy" e "But I like it."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I work in the fiscal team." To work means to…
options: have a job or do a task
items.why: Work = trabalhar, fazer uma tarefa.

items.q: "Please check the numbers again." To check means to…
options: look at something to see if it is correct
items.why: Check = conferir, olhar para ver se está certo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ the form to my manager by email."
items.why: Send = enviar. Você envia o formulário ao gestor.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The manager reads the form and then he ___ it at the bottom."
items.why: Sign = assinar. O gestor assina o formulário no fim.

items.q: "We file the form in the fiscal folder." To file means to…
options: put a document in order and keep it
items.why: File = arquivar / declarar: guardar o documento em ordem.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com formulários. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill out the tax form." To fill out means to…
options: write your answers in all the spaces
items.why: Fill out = preencher: escrever as respostas nos campos.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We send out the forms every month." To send out means to…
options: to keep them in a drawer
items.why: Send out = enviar (para fora), mandar para as pessoas.

items.q: "Please hand in the form before the deadline." To hand in means to…
options: to give it to the right person
items.why: Hand in = entregar (à pessoa certa).

items.q: "I will follow up with the accountant tomorrow." To follow up means to…
options: to check again and ask about it later
items.why: Follow up = dar sequência, verificar/perguntar depois.
